# End-to-end journey coverage detection

Implements analysis to detect whether there are tests that truly exercise an entire multi-step journey (user flow) end-to-end, not just individual components. This addresses the problem that 100% step-by-step coverage does not guarantee the whole journey is ever tested as a chain, exposing test slip risks.
